sourceOfTruth.rule: VISIBLE MASTER OVERRIDES PREVIOUS INTENDED FONT NAMES

auditFinding.reason: Raster glyph matching against the approved master shows the visible serif is materially closer to Noto Serif Bold than Noto Serif Display SemiBold, while body/UI is materially closer to Inter.

bodyXL.rule: Preserve emitted utility even if no current componentRoleMap entry uses it. Do not silently delete it.

h4.rule: Existing text-h4-* utilities remain valid during migration; card components should converge on cardH3 metrics.

resolutionNotes.A_caption: RESOLVED: caption is a first-class semantic role at 12px / 1.5 / 500. Existing text-caption utilities must continue to emit CSS.
resolutionNotes.B_cardSizing: RESOLVED: structural H3 remains 28/24. Card title H3 is a separate visual role at 22 desktop / 20 mobile and intentionally matches the legacy h4 metrics. Do not use structuralH3 for cards.
resolutionNotes.C_orphans: RESOLVED: form roles are assigned to concrete form components in TYPOGRAPHY_IMPLEMENTATION_MAP; bodyXL is explicitly preserved as compatibility-only rather than treated as an orphan semantic role.

tokenEmissionContract.rule: Tailwind font-size tokens MUST NOT be rebuilt from semanticRoles alone. Emit the union of semanticRoles + compatibilityTokens + any existing typography utility still referenced by source code until that source usage is migrated in the same commit.
tokenEmissionContract.buildGuardDescription: During PHA 2, scan referenced typography utilities and fail if any referenced token has no generated CSS/computed typography. This explicitly covers text-caption and prevents recurrence of silent off-scale utility failures.

confidence.note: Original font metadata cannot be recovered from the flattened raster master; confidence refers to implementation match, not provenance.
